title: A shelf tile says where the component came from
goal: On the Library shelf of a new document, a component you made in another file, one of the app's five starters and a component in this document all look exactly the same: same picture, same violet mark, same caption. You cannot tell what is already in your file from what a drop would bring in. Give a tile one plain word under it that says which it is.
notes: The detail line is already on every LibraryEntry and already correct ("shared", "starter", "2 copies"); LibraryComponentTile just never draws it. See Sources/Photonz/ComponentPanel.swift, LibraryComponentTile, and LibraryShelfLayout for the room a caption has. Raised by the audit queue/audits/2026-09-12-shared-components.json.
acceptance: A tile for a component on the shared shelf reads differently at a glance from a tile for a component in this document
A starter tile does the same
Nothing is added that makes a tile taller or the shelf hold fewer of them
A walk photographs a shelf holding all three kinds at once
